note: Gate B W3 — B06 League/Event match comparison. Four candidates: League Before/After (confirms the shipped Match Details BEFORE/AFTER composition as the comparison baseline) and Event Before/After (a UI-Lab-local design proposal for a standalone Event Match Details layout, composed from real production pieces — not a production route). All four remain CANDIDATE pending owner review. A retrospective remediation (B3-R1 through B3-R7, same session as B05/W2's own retrospective fix) corrected League · After's and Event · After's fixtures/navigation (fixtureVersion 2) and League · Before's/Event · Before's coach-facing copy and navigation (no fixture data change, fixtureVersion unchanged), and added two new real origin pages (league/match-details, event/event-detail) — see docs/ui-lab/gate-b-w3-candidates/SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md and BLOCKERS.md. Fresh real CI capture evidence against the remediated revision is committed in capture-attestation.json: run https://github.com/lagebj/matchboard/actions/runs/39657393171 (reviewedBranchHeadSha 568096efc0f2d89b85eaaa90ad4b2fedf0b16612), 40 captures, all 40 hashes independently re-verified. The pre-remediation run (39637600700, 1c185cc01f8a6ee46f958792e0b04e8105f86b05, also 40 captures) is preserved for traceability under capture-attestation.json's own priorVersions[0] — it was CANDIDATE only and never approved, so nothing is inherited from it. fixtureVersion bumped to 3 for B06-EVENT-AFTER only (its own fixture DATA changed — debriefAnswers.player_observations, combinationEvidence.subtype; new fixtureSha256 in fixtures.ts). The other three candidates' underlying fixture data is unchanged by this session's B5/R2/B5/R6 findings. See SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md for the full finding-by-finding record (B5/R2, B5/R6, B5/R7). Real CI capture evidence for this final revision (commit fcac097a1) is committed in capture-attestation.json: run https://github.com/lagebj/matchboard/actions/runs/39695163167, 60 B06 captures (including the two new navigation-page scenarios, registered for the first time — B5/R7), all hashes independently re-verified.

candidates.baselineAssetRef: CONFIRMS_SHIPPED_BASELINE — real League Match Details BEFORE composition (MatchIdentityCard + MatchPreparationWidget + planning pitch); see VISUAL_VS_CURRENT.md
knownGaps: Live Reporting stage rendered as a disclosed fact, not reproduced (shared production surface).

B5/R2: debriefAnswers.player_observations still named William (participant-gb6e-william, a GUEST_PLAYER) with an individual structured observation — the standalone footballObservations record had already been reassigned to Theodor (B3-R3), but the debrief's OWN player_observations array (a second real path production's debrief-submission flow can promote into the identical createFootballObservations() call, which requires an active canonical Player) was never audited. Corrected: reassigned to Theodor as well, matching footballObservations exactly. William's real participation (lineup slot, attendance, the match_changes narrative) is preserved; only the structured, Player-backed observation record moved. Both evidence paths are now covered by a dedicated test asserting every entry resolves to an eligible PLAYER participant.

B5/R6: the Noah+Sindre combination row's subtype was HORIZONTAL, but Noah plays CF (FORWARD -> line ATT) and Sindre plays LCM (MIDFIELDER -> line MID) — different lines, so the real derivePartnershipSubtype() (combination-topology.ts) returns VERTICAL, never HORIZONTAL (same line only). Corrected, and verified against the real, unmodified deriveCombinationsFromSegments() with constructed segments/goal events for this exact match in a new __tests__/combination-evidence.test.ts — every field on this row now equals that function's own real output, not a hand-picked value. The equivalent B05 row (Noah RCM + Sindre LCM, same line -> correctly HORIZONTAL) is verified the same way in b05-post-match-report/shared/__tests__/combination-evidence.test.ts.

B5/R7: capture-attestation.json is regenerated against this revision's own real, passing CI capture run. Two real navigation pages created during the earlier B3-R5 remediation (league/match-details, event/event-detail) were never registered in the capture script and had zero real capture evidence despite being linked from every Before/After page — found and fixed in this same pass (now registered; see BLOCKERS.md).
